Jerry Balmuth
Jerome "Jerry" Balmuth (born May 8, 1924-September 28, 2017) is an American philosoher and the Harry Emerson Fosdick Professor of Philosophy and Religion, Emeritus, at Colgate University in Hamilton, New York.
